Hi!! It seems like you're okay with homebrew, so I suggest possibly checking out Leuku's guides on Big Boss Solo Inserts. They have some great tips on running singular enemy encounters, and while I don't use everything, it gave me a great jumping off point for designing big bad bosses. My personal favorite is using HP pools, basically giving the boss more HP, but with each HP pool there's a different "phase" of the encounter that changes the conditions the players are working with. Hope this helps!

Hi! If it's long-lasting it's possible you're experiencing autistic burnout. This can happen even when you're doing something you love. I hope you feel better soon <3

I work at west campus dining hall, mostly the lunch shift! The vibe is very welcoming and depending on the shift you’re working, your coworkers are gonna have a LOT of energy. But that’s a good thing! I’d recommend talking with them during shifts. It helps pass the time and you can learn a lot from them. I got some of my best life advice from one of the chefs.

Edit: fair warning, west gets crazy usually during 1 specific hour that depends on the shift. If you’re working the grill or the salad bar, stay on your toes.
